description: This file defines a class 'ADODB2_access' that extends 'ADODB_DataDict' to handle database schema operations specific to Microsoft Access within the ADOdb PHP library. It includes methods for type conversion, SQL suffix generation for columns, and placeholder functions for database and schema modifications.

classes.name: ADODB2_access
classes.description: A class that provides Access-specific implementations for database schema management within the ADOdb PHP library.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts metadata types into actual database types specific to Access, considering custom meta types.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffix strings for column definitions, including handling 'NOT NULL' and constraints.

methods.name: CreateDatabase
methods.description: Stub method for creating a database, currently returns an empty array.

methods.name: SetSchema
methods.description: Placeholder method for setting schema, not implemented.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Stub for generating SQL to alter columns, not supported in this implementation.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Stub for generating SQL to drop columns, not supported in this implementation.
